attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration of Allied Mental Health and Human Services Professions

rules.accepted_credit_types: Contact hours from Board-recognized Entities / entity-approved sponsors (list of Board-approved providers in the Board FAQ).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First cycle prorated by issue date: Jan 1-Jun 30 of an even year 22.5; Jul 1-Dec 31 of an even year 15; Jan 1-Jun 30 of an odd year 7.5.
rules.audit_note: Random audits up to two years after renewal; keep documentation four years (title, hours, sponsor, approving entity, date, attendance proof).

topics.who: Board-approved domestic and sexual violence training, completed once; earns 2 CEs in that cycle (M.G.L. c. 112, s. 264)
Acknowledge child abuse/neglect reporting obligations at renewal, incl. completion of training to recognize and report (M.G.L. c. 112, s. 1A)

rules.notes: 30 contact hours (50-minute units) per two-year licensure/renewal period. Waivers or extensions only in extreme situations, requested before renewal.
rules.rule_quote: (1) All licensees are required, as a condition of license renewal, to complete a minimum of 30 Contact Hours of continuing education activities per licensure/renewal period (every two years).
